guides.title: New since 2025, and Tina's already been
guides.lede: Three places that opened recently, in the order they opened: candlepin and flatbread in the Canal District, stir-fry off Route 9, and the Mongolian BBQ that got Tina to Leominster.

note.text: Thank goodness Hungry Bowl opened in Leominster.

stops.say: Wood-fired flatbread upstairs and ten candlepin lanes downstairs, inside The Cove. It brought public candlepin back to Worcester for the first time since Colonial Bowling closed in 2020.
Made-to-order stir-fry and salads at Lakeway Commons, right off Route 9. Pick a protein and a base; the honeybars are the dessert.
Her first Mongolian BBQ, and the reason this guide heads north up I-190.
stops.extra: Mongolian BBQ, about 30 minutes up I-190

guides.title: Shrewsbury Street, stop by stop
guides.lede: Restaurant Row in street-number order, from Leo Turo Way out toward Route 9. Tina has posted from nine of these eleven; the Boulevard Diner and Leo's are still on her list.

note.text: Do not miss out on the haddock or the brussel sprouts.

guides.lede: One roof at 160 Green St in the Canal District, and the four counters Tina keeps coming back to. Park once, eat four times.

Korean fusion: tacos, loaded potatoes, and whatever the special is.
